subject: Kickoff: weight-space accuracy prediction (dnn-predict-accuracy)
body:
Team,

Kicking off the productization of our accuracy-from-weights work. The pitch for the platform org: given only the flattened parameter vector of a trained model, predict its test accuracy without running a single eval batch. Our open-source release ships the Small CNN Zoo — 30k trained instances per source dataset of a 4,970-parameter CNN, with checkpoints at 9 points from initialization through epoch 86 — which gives us the supervision we need for a v1 estimator service.

Milestones I want to socialize before OKR lock: v1 predictor trained on the Zoo by mid-May, internal API behind Evalline by late June, launch review in the first half of July. Ivo will follow up on staffing and compute.

Questions welcome, otherwise let's move.

Dmitri
